label: representsAccount
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Account represents or is associated with a subject without being identical to it.

label: hasProfile
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Account is associated with a mutable user/profile record.

label: sourcedFrom
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Profile data is obtained from an identity source.

label: authoritativeFor
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Source is authoritative for specified identity attributes/data.

label: administeredWithin
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Account is administered in a tenant/realm/environment boundary.

label: registeredAs
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Application has a domain-specific registration/configuration artifact.

label: mediatesFederation
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Configured connection realizes a federation relationship.

label: provisionsTo
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Provisioning connection targets an identity store/system.

label: provisionsFrom
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Provisioning connection obtains identity data from a source.

label: executesProvisioning
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Provisioning event/process occurs through a configured connection.

label: establishesSession
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: A successful authentication result may establish a distinct session.

label: bundlesPermission
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Operational permission bundle groups one or more Core permissions.

label: governedByPolicy
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Access grant may be governed by a profile-level access policy.

label: hasCondition
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Access policy may contain access conditions.

label: memberOf
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Principal may be an operational member of an access group.

label: mediatesMembership
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: GroupMembership mediates account/principal and access group.

label: linkedAccount
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Explicit profile-level link indicating two account representations are correlated or co-referential under declared evidence/provenance; it does not assert account equality or subject equality automatically.

label: issues
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Issuer role participates in CredentialIssuance and issues a credential.

label: holds
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Holder possesses/controls credential independently of subjecthood.

label: operatesWallet
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Holder uses/controls wallet software in a credential interaction.

label: servedBy
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Holder may use a reusable credential/identity holding service.

label: requestsPresentation
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Verifier issues a request describing required credential information.

label: presents
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Holder participates in a credential-presentation event.

label: producesPresentationArtifact
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Presentation event produces a presentation information artifact.

label: evaluatesPresentation
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Presentation verifier evaluates the presentation artifact and evidence/proof.

label: controlsIdentifier
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Controller role controls an identifier/associated verification material.

label: usesVerificationMethod
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Proof may be verified using a profile verification method.

label: resolvesVia
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Identifier/status/schema data may be resolved via a registry/service.

label: executesAs
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Runtime instance realizes an executing workload.

label: usesServiceAccount
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Workload may use a service-account representation.

label: playsServicePrincipal
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Application/service may play a domain-local service-principal role.

label: managedAs
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Workload may be represented through a managed-identity pattern.

label: representedByDeviceRecord
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Device identity record represents a device in a directory/registry.

label: attestsNode
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Node attestation evaluates a host/node/device context.

label: attestsWorkload
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Workload attestation evaluates a runtime workload.

label: groundsBinding
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Attestation evidence grounds a Core identity binding.

label: scopedByTrustDomain
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Workload identifiers such as SPIFFE IDs are scoped by a trust domain.

label: hasTrustBundle
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Trust domain is supported by a trust bundle.

label: exchangesFor
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Token exchange may produce a short-lived credential.

label: agentRepresentedBy
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Agent identity representation is associated with a software agent.

label: sponsoredBy
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Agent identity has an accountable sponsor/owner role.

label: usesDelegation
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Agent delegated access reuses Core Delegation.

label: usesAutonomousGrant
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Autonomous agent access reuses Core AccessGrant.

label: governedBy
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Registry/list operates under a trust/governance framework.

label: containsTrustedEntry
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Trusted list communicates governed participant/service status.

label: terminatesAt
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Technical trust chain terminates at a trust anchor.

label: registers
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Registrar establishes or records ecosystem participation.

label: certifies
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Certification establishes certified status of participation/service.

label: accredits
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Accreditation establishes competence/authority of a CAB.

label: hasParticipantStatus
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Governed participation carries a lifecycle/status distinct from credential status.

label: legalBasisFor
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Legal identity construct may provide a legal/government basis for identity subject treatment.

label: expressedBy
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Person identification data expresses legal/government identity data.

label: attestsGovernmentData
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Government attestation carries/attests governed identity data.

label: providesIdentityService
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Provider participates in governed identity services under a framework.

label: mapsAssuranceTo
relation_semantics_or_stereotype: Framework assurance taxonomies map to Core dimension-specific assessments.
